description: Appointments from the Client Portal. status "scheduled" returns confirmed/upcoming ones; "requested" returns those still awaiting the practice's confirmation. Pages by number.

status.description: Which side of the pending-confirmation filter to read.

view.description: compact returns the slim projection where one exists and strips image URLs elsewhere; "full" returns SimplePractice's whole records. "brief" answers one text line per item — title — <ISO date or "no date"> — <status> — for a host that only needs to say what is there, with "-- " note lines for an empty or full page.

name: simplepractice_list_appointments
